package planted

// A PLANTED instance of the defect class fetchtags_guard_test.go catches: go-git fetch options
// that follow tags. The guard MUST flag lines 13 and 17 and pass line 21.

import (
	gogit "github.com/go-git/go-git/v5"
)

var specs = []string{"+refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*"}

func plantedDefault(r *gogit.Remote) error {
	return r.Fetch(&gogit.FetchOptions{RefSpecs: nil})
}

func plantedAllTags(r *gogit.Remote) error {
	return r.Fetch(&gogit.FetchOptions{Tags: gogit.AllTags})
}

func clean(r *gogit.Remote) error {
	return r.Fetch(&gogit.FetchOptions{Tags: gogit.NoTags})
}
